definitions: A Fijian dish of raw fish marinated in citrus juice (especially lime or lemon), typically mixed with coconut cream, onions, chillies, and tomatoes; the Fijian version of ceviche.

blocks.text: Kokoda is a station town in the Oro Province of Papua New Guinea. It is famous as the northern end of the Kokoda Track, site of the eponymous Kokoda Track campaign of World War II. In that campaign, it had strategic significance because it had the only airfield along the Track. In the decades preceding, it had been a foothills settlement near the gold fields.
Kokoda is a 2006 Australian war film directed by Alister Grierson and is based on the experiences of Australian troops fighting Japanese forces during the 1942 Kokoda Track campaign.
